estimator: OpenVINS mono MSCKF with local SLAM features, fixed supplied camera calibration
ground_truth_usage: Evaluation only after the isolated estimator exits; one fixed first-matched-pose SE(3) alignment, no scale fit or trajectory-wide alignment; no GT initialization/feedback

reference_matching.method: nearest provided ground-truth sample, maximum 10 ms; no interpolated reference

limitations: Only a short public monochrome dataset subset, not phone/road acceptance
Mono VIO, not a global loop-closing/relocalizing SLAM demonstration
Initial static initialization is stock OpenVINS; initialization delay remains visible
No GT read by the C++ runner; CSV positions have estimator scale before evaluation
Docker wall time includes startup, decode and mounted-file I/O; not a matched speed comparison with Windows ONNX runs
